$comment: Expected live Supabase Auth configuration. Single source of truth for scripts/security/auth_config_drift.py (read-only Management API audit, protected supabase-drift job on main). Pins security-relevant values only; never add secrets or cosmetic fields. Change the live project and this file together. See supabase/AUTH_EMAIL_OTP.md.

site_url.evidence: Fixed live 2026-09-01 (was eatova://login-callback/, magic-link takeover path); read back 2026-09-07 (docs/REVIEW-2026-09-07.md section 5).

rate_limit_email_sent.evidence: Project-wide mail bucket; fixed live 2026-09-01 (was 2/h); read back 2026-09-07.

rate_limit_verify.evidence: Per-IP verify bucket the 8-digit brute-force calculation relies on (AUTH_EMAIL_OTP.md, 2026-08-18; read 2026-09-01). Lowering is allowed only with a new calculation.

mailer_otp_length.evidence: Read back 2026-09-20; must equal kAccountCodeLength in the app.

mailer_secure_email_change_enabled.evidence: Read back 2026-09-20; both mailboxes must confirm an address change.

mailer_autoconfirm.evidence: UNCONFIRMED in repo docs: last read 2026-09-01 (review notes). Needs one read-only live confirmation before merge.

security_update_password_require_current.evidence: Enabled in the 2026-09-20 password rollout (PR #100); audited since then.

security_refresh_token_reuse_interval.evidence: Read back 2026-09-07; the lifecycle probe tests this interval.

jwt_exp.evidence: Read back 2026-09-07; bounds stateless validity of revoked access tokens.

password_min_length.evidence: UNCONFIRMED in repo docs: last read 2026-09-01 (review notes); equals kAccountMinPasswordLength. Needs one read-only live confirmation before merge.

external_anonymous_users_enabled.evidence: UNCONFIRMED: never documented as read live; all local Auth probes model it as false. Needs one read-only live confirmation before merge.

external_apple_enabled.evidence: UNCONFIRMED in repo docs: last read 2026-09-01 (review notes); the app exposes no Apple login. Needs one read-only live confirmation before merge.

external_google_enabled.evidence: UNCONFIRMED as a read value; implied by the working Google login (OAUTH_SETUP.md). Needs one read-only live confirmation before merge.

uri_allow_list.evidence: Exact set. Entries documented in OAUTH_SETUP.md and AUTH_EMAIL_OTP.md (2026-09-20); that no other entry exists is UNCONFIRMED and needs one read-only live confirmation before merge.

templates.evidence: Generated by scripts/auth_email_templates.py, published 2026-09-20 and read back byte-exact; live content must equal the versioned files.
